message.anime_multiverse.dungeon.admin.n: This command needs a player to act on. Run it in game, or as a player with /execute as <player> run dungeon ...
The Mega-Dungeon dimension is not loaded on this server.
You are not on a floor of the Mega-Dungeon (you are in %1$s).
You are in the Mega-Dungeon but on no floor (a gap between two sectors). Walk onto a floor first.
message.anime_multiverse.dungeon.admin.f: That did not work: %1$s. The server log has the details.
message.anime_multiverse.dungeon.admin.t: Floor %1$s is out of range. Use -1000 to +1000 (0 is the Sanctuary Hub).
This is a boss floor: the Guardian waits at the end of it.
Floor %1$s lies inside a ten-floor sector (floors %2$s to %3$s): you stand at the sector's landing.
Teleported to Floor 0, the Sanctuary Hub.
Floor 0 cannot be reached: the Sanctuary dimension is not loaded.
Floor %1$s is not built yet. %2$s floor(s) are queued (about %3$s seconds); you are teleported the moment it stands. Use /dungeon tp again to replace the request.
Building the way to floor %1$s: %2$s%% (%3$s floor(s) to go)
The earlier teleport request to floor %1$s is dropped.
The Directional Lock closes the %1$s to you. Free yourself first: /multiverse mega floors unlock <you> (or floors set <you> <road>), or turn floors.opsBypass on.
The dungeon has no free lane for your party. Raise party.maxParties.
Floor %1$s does not exist yet and the dungeon cannot grow: mega.expansion is switched off.
The dungeon reached its limit of %1$s sectors (mega.maxSectors) before floor %2$s. Raise the limit in the server config.
A floor on the way failed to generate (sector %1$s). Retry it with /multiverse mega regen %1$s, then run the teleport again.
The dungeon has not moved for %1$s seconds, so the teleport to floor %2$s is cancelled. Check /multiverse mega status.
The generator refused the next floor: %1$s
Sector %1$s has no landing to stand on (its data is incomplete). See the server log.
message.anime_multiverse.dungeon.admin.s: You are on Floor 0: there is nothing behind it. Skip forward, or use /dungeon tp.
Skipping %1$s floor(s) %2$s from floor %3$s, to floor %4$s.
The skip was cut short: the road ends at floor %1$s (+-1000), and going back stops at Floor 0.
message.anime_multiverse.dungeon.admin.b: Dungeon level %1$s does not exist. Use -100 to -1 (Abyssal road) or 1 to 100 (Holy road); 0 is the Hub.
The boss of level %1$s (floor %2$s) appears at %3$s.
No boss could be spawned for level %1$s here.
Slew %1$s boss(es) near you. A Mana Core drops for the Gatekeeper.
There is no boss within reach to slay.
message.anime_multiverse.dungeon.admin.r: No rift could be opened at %1$s: the place is not free, or a shortcut needs a floor of the Mega-Dungeon under you.
Alignment cleared: no road, no lock, no record of the deepest floors, and the tracker forgot your floor.
Waypoint cleared, with the memory of the deepest Landing: the next entry starts at the first floor.
You had no waypoint and no deepest-Landing memory; nothing to clear.
Everything of the dungeon is cleared for you: alignment and waypoint.
message.anime_multiverse.dungeon.admin.d: WFC debug ON for %1$s minutes (or until you leave the dimension). Green = on a loop, yellow = single link, red = dead end. Run it again to stop.
WFC debug switched itself off: the %1$s minutes are over.
WFC debug switched itself off: you left the dimension.
WFC debug needs a built floor of the Mega-Dungeon under you.
Floor %1$s (sector %2$s): %3$s rooms, %4$s doorways, dead ends %5$s, loops %6$s, rooms on a loop %7$s, single-link rooms %8$s, separate parts %9$s.
OK: no dead ends, one connected floor.
PROBLEM: %1$s dead end(s) and %2$s separate part(s); the red rooms and lines show where.
Sector %1$s on the %2$s road, party %3$s, state %4$s, %5$s rooms%6$s.
Floor 0, the Sanctuary Hub: no level, no theme, no seed of its own.
You are outside the dungeon. Your waypoint: %1$s.
message.anime_multiverse.dungeon.admin.h: Dungeon admin commands (permission level 2). They act on you; use /execute as <player> run dungeon ... for someone else:
Teleport to a floor (-1000 to +1000, 0 is the Hub); a floor not built yet is queued and you go the moment it stands.
Go forward one floor along your road (a negative number goes back towards the Hub).
Go forward that many floors (-1000 to 1000).
Spawn the Decennial boss of a dungeon level (-100 to -1, 1 to 100) where you stand.
Slay the boss near you; its Mana Core drops to test the Gatekeeper.
Open a pocket-dungeon rift at your crosshair.
Open a floor-shortcut rift at your crosshair.
Forget your road, the lock and the deepest floors.
Forget your waypoint and the deepest Landing.
Toggle the particle view of this floor's room graph (green loop, yellow single link, red dead end).
Say the floor, level, theme and seed you are standing in.
